body: ## Pull request overview This PR attempts to fix CI failures caused by non-existent Python and Ruby versions in the `.mise.toml` configuration file. The original configuration specified Python 3.14.3 (not yet released) and Ruby 3.4.8 (pre-release), which were causing Docker build failures. The PR updates these to stable versions and bumps the container tag to force a rebuild. **Changes:** - Updated Python from 3.14.3 to 3.12.8 in `.mise.toml` - Updated Ruby from 3.4.8 to 3.3.6 in `.mise.toml` - Bumped container tag from 0.36 to 0.37 - Modified `vmv.v.i` instruction operation logic (unrelated to PR description) ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 2 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | .mise.toml | Updated Python to 3.12.8 and Ruby to 3.3.6 for mise tool management | | bin/.container-tag | Bumped container version from 0.36 to 0.37 to trigger rebuild | | spec/std/isa/inst/V/vmv.v.i.yaml | Added boundary condition handling for vector move immediate operation | --- 💡 Add Copilot custom instructions for smarter, more guided reviews.
